userStories.title: iOS: reconciliation link/create refreshes the local cache
userStories.description: As a user reconciling orphan listings, I want a linked/created item to immediately show its listing — today after linking, the item still shows zero listings until who-knows-when.
acceptanceCriteria: After 'Link item' / 'Create item' in ReconciliationView, the local SwiftData cache is updated (optimistically + via a targeted sync) so the item's canvas shows the now-linked listing

userStories.notes: [P2][iOS/Cohesion] DONE. ROOT CAUSE found: the item canvas shows listings from the `listings` table (LocalListing @Query), but iOS ReconciliationService.createItem/link only flipped flipdesk_ebay_listings.matched_item_id and NEVER wrote a `listings` row — so the canvas showed 0 listings (the WEB reconciliation, src/components/flipdesk/ebay-sku-match.tsx, DOES insert/upsert a listings row on both create + link; iOS didn't). FIX: ReconciliationService now mirrors the live eBay listing into `listings` on create (best-effort — never strands the created item) AND link (surfaces failure → .failed → retry-safe since it's select-then-insert/update), via upsertEbayListingRow + a pure, tested ebayListingMirrorFields(from:) mapping (platform_listing_id=ebayItemId, listing_url/title pass-through, listing_price defaults 0; listing_origin=ebay, listing_status=active, is_active, listed_at only on insert) — RLS scopes listings through the owned parent item, no user_id needed. ReconciliationView.applyOutcome now (1) optimistically drops the resolved orphan [AC2], (2) HapticFeedback.success() confirms it worked, (3) awaits syncEngine.sync() (fallback: .inventoryPullRequested) to land the LocalListing so the canvas shows it [AC1]. AC3 (failure surfaced) was already met by both sheets' inline error alerts; Create's redundant notification post removed (centralized). Tests: ReconcileListingMirrorTests (pass-through + price-defaults-0 / nil-safe). iOS UNVERIFIED here (no macOS/xcodebuild); no-ungated-print passes. acceptanceCriteria: Sign-in with an unconfirmed account shows dedicated guidance (not the raw error string) including the address the mail was sent to

userStories.title: SES bounce/complaint suppression loop
userStories.description: As the platform, I want hard bounces and spam complaints to automatically suppress an address so the autonomous sender never repeatedly mails bad/angry recipients — the safety mechanism that makes hands-off sending viable and protects sender reputation.
acceptanceCriteria: New migration adds email_suppressions (email unique, reason enum(hard_bounce,complaint,manual,unsubscribe_all), source, created_at, notes).

Admin can view suppressions and manually remove a false-positive suppression (audited, super_admin).
Test: a hard-bounce notification suppresses the address and the next campaign skips it.
